run_extract_sentence_embeddings: run the extract_features CLI to encode sentences from text files into numpy embedding arrays
run_build_vocab_and_encode: run extract_features to build a vocabulary from sentences and encode them with a pretrained InferSent model
run_save_embeddings_as_npy: run extract_features to save sentence embeddings as .npy files in a specified output directory
run_extract_features_with_cpu: run extract_features with the --cpu flag to extract embeddings on CPU instead of GPU
run_extract_features_with_tokenize: run extract_features with the --tokenize flag to tokenize input sentences before building vocabulary and encoding
